title: The Real Essence of Nectar
author: Śrīla Bhakti Sundar Govinda Dev-Goswāmī Mahārāj

translation: “What is Kṛṣṇa-līlā? It is the real essence of nectar. It is the gist of sweetness, happiness, and ecstasy. The sweetness of the sweetest thing that can ever be conceived of is represented in Kṛṣṇa-līlā. Then what is Chaitanya-līlā? In Chaitanya-līlā, that sweet nectar of Kṛṣṇa-līlā is flowing in all ten directions in hundreds of streams as if from a fountain. That fountain is Chaitanya-līlā.”

All the devotees like to read *Śrī Chaitanya-charitāmṛta* and I have also read it many times, but the meaning is not always apparent to us. The real meaning comes through our service, so we must try wholeheartedly and happily to serve, even though sometimes service may not come so happily to us. Sometimes it may give us pain or difficulty.
